context:
Goal: joyous's rules say who decides, and never let a price reach a public page.
Problem (rule): each fix changes a rule's words or adds one, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): the Opus judges' report (22:05 CST); an archive page shows $1,000/month, and no test stops a price.
Based on (read): CLAUDE.md calls you "the builder", but the glossary says a builder is an agent.
Departs from: joyous CLAUDE.md — deletes lines 58-59 (every lane follows compliance-check and ci-hygiene); "builder" becomes "owner" and the school's "owner(s)" becomes "school owner(s)"; adds a rule: no public page shows tuition.

lastAnswer.note: Read 08:04 CST. Lane joyous-claude-md-fixes builds it; open until it merges.

options.gain: Clear names, and no price can go live by mistake.
options.how: One joyous lane edits CLAUDE.md and adds a red test for any price on a public page.
options.label: Apply all 3
options.lose: The skills line goes; those skills still start on their own triggers.

options.label: Leave as is
options.lose: A ported page can still publish a price.

title: joyous: drop the skills line, say "owner" not "builder", and add a no-public-tuition rule?
why: Recommended: a. An old page in the archive shows $1,000/month, and nothing stops a ported page from publishing it.
